mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_STORE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO STORE (STORE_ID, MEMBER_ID, STORE_NAME, CATEGORY, DESCRIPTION, PHONE, ADDRESS, TARGET_CUSTOMER, TARGET_DESCRIPTION, TONE_MANNER, TONE_DESCRIPTION, BRAND_COLOR, HERO_IMAGE_URL, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{s.storeId}, #{memberId}, #{s.storeName}, #{s.category}, #{s.description}, #{s.phone}, #{s.address}, #{s.targetCustomer}, #{s.targetDescription}, #{s.toneManner}, #{s.toneDescription}, #{s.brandColor}, #{s.heroImageUrl}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE STORE SET STORE_NAME = #{storeName}, CATEGORY = #{category}, PHONE = #{phone}, BRAND_COLOR = #{brandColor}, TARGET_CUSTOMER = #{targetCustomer}, TARGET_DESCRIPTION = #{targetDescription}, TONE_MANNER = #{toneManner}, TONE_DESCRIPTION = #{toneDescription}, HERO_IMAGE_URL = #{heroImageUrl}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId}
UPDATE STORE SET HERO_IMAGE_URL = #{url}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId}
mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_PRODUCT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO PRODUCT (PRODUCT_ID, STORE_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, PRICE, DESCRIPTION, IMAGE_URL, SALE_STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{p.productId}, #{storeId}, #{p.productName}, #{p.price}, #{p.description}, #{p.imageUrl}, 'ON_SALE', SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET PRODUCT_NAME = #{p.productName}, PRICE = #{p.price}, DESCRIPTION = #{p.description}, IMAGE_URL = #{p.imageUrl}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{p.productId} AND STORE_ID = #{storeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STORE_IMAGE (STORE_IMAGE_ID, PRODUCT_ID, STORE_ID, IMAGE_STYLE, MOOD, SCENE, EXTRA_REQUEST, IMAGE_URL, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_STORE_IMAGE.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{storeId}, #{imageStyle}, #{mood}, #{scene}, #{extraRequest}, #{imageUrl}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(CREATED_AT) FROM STORE_IMAGE WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM STORE_IMAGE WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId} AND CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')
